name: Scott C Hege

bio.statement: The Capital Chronicle voter guide says Hege is a Wasco County commissioner and engineer from The Dalles.
bio.excerpt: Scott Hege is a Wasco County commissioner and engineer from The Dalles.

bio.statement: The guide says he formerly worked as executive director of the Port of The Dalles.
bio.excerpt: He formerly worked as executive director of the Port of The Dalles.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Hege says he is committed to improving the business climate.
positions.excerpt: I am committed to improving the business climate, which currently negatively impacts nearly all businesses

positions.statement: He says transportation maintenance should be the top priority and funding should first be preceded by an audit of the transportation department.
positions.excerpt: Funding for the Department of Transportation should be addressed by first conducting a comprehensive audit of the organization.

positions.statement: On wildfire, Hege says the state needs to deal with fuels in forested lands.
positions.excerpt: We need to deal with the fuels that are overtaking our forested lands.

positions.statement: He says Oregon's tax and regulatory structure adds to the cost of doing business.
positions.excerpt: Oregon’s overall tax and regulatory structure adds to the cost of doing business

positions.statement: The Capital Chronicle reports Hege said he does not support taking local control away from communities on data center investment.
positions.excerpt: I do not support taking local control away from communities who could benefit from the investment;
